name: AI
body: Most folks bring their own AI provider API key to power Metabase's AI features. If you use our AI service, it's $3.75 per 1M tokens, and includes 1 million tokens to get you started.
included: 1 million tokens to get you started

name: Transforms
body: You get 1,000 included runs on Starter and Pro. After 1,000, each run costs $0.01 and we bill you monthly for your usage. By self-hosting you get unlimited transforms, since they run on your own infrastructure.

name: Advanced transforms
body: Just like regular transforms, you get 1,000 included runs on Starter and Pro. Advanced transforms cost $0.02 per run once you have used your included runs.

name: Storage
body: Storage is completely optional, for when your data is not already in a database and you would rather upload spreadsheets or CSVs to analyse in Metabase. Pricing starts at $2 for 1M rows of storage.
